Game Overview

At its heart, Eggdog Helix Jumper is a hyper-casual game about guide the lovable Eggdog through spiraling towers in this delightful twist on the classic helix genre. Rotate platforms to aid Eggdog's descent, skillfully avoiding forbidden zones to achieve the longest drop. Enjoy an engaging arcade experience with charming gameplay and endless fun.
